notes.title: Cubox Game like Minecraft+Tibia+Diablo+Don't Strave Play with Dev Online
notes.content:
Hi i am developer of Cubox. 
Download Client and play with me Online Build,castles,destroy enemies and other players,craft resources.
Cubox is an MMORPG inspired by titles such as Minecraft, Diablo, Tibia and Don't Starve which will be available on Steam, Google Play and the App Store. 
The game offers a variety of weapon types, mobs, bosses and character customisation options. Experience the endless world alone or form guilds as you build, craft and upgrade;
with over 1500 different blocks, equipment and items to choose from. Equip yourself with a variety of bows, earth-shattering magic, swords and shields as you seek out both PVE and PVP.
The world is yours to explore.

See you on stream 4.2.21 4PM :)
